output.original_text: hahaha ni fa abinda yake matukar bani mamaki shine kungiyar miyetti allah tace ita tayi nasarar ceto daliban makarantar kankara rundunar sojojin nigeria tace ita tayi nasarar ceto daliban makarantar kankara rundunar yan sandan lntelligence agencies taceitatayi ceto daliba
output.joy: Hahaha, abu mai ban dariya ne da gaske! Kungiyar Miyetti Allah ta yi nasarar ceto daliban makarantar Kankara, kuma rundunar sojojin Najeriya ma sun ce sun yi nasarar ceto su! Hakan yana da kyau sosai!
output.sadness: Hahaha, abin da ke bani mamaki, amma yana da wuyar sha'ani. Kungiyar Miyetti Allah ta ce ta ceto daliban makarantar Kankara, to, shin fa wannan na nuna halin da muke ciki a kasar mu?
output.fear: Hahaha, abinda ya matukar bani mamaki, amma a gaskiya, wannan yana da fargaba. Kungiyar Miyetti Allah ta ce ta ceto daliban makarantar Kankara, to, me zai faru idan har hakan ba gaskiya ba ne?
output.anger: Hahaha, abin da ke bani mamaki, amma ya kamata muyi la’akari da gaskiyar lamarin. Kungiyar Miyetti Allah ta ce ta ceto daliban Kankara - me yasa muke jami’ai na tsaro, idan suna sake samowa ga wannan gagarimin matsala?
output.surprise: Hahaha, Wannan abin yana da ban mamaki! Kungiyar Miyetti Allah ta ce ta yi nasarar ceto daliban makarantar Kankara? Wannan abu yana da wahala a yi imani da shi!
output.disgust: Hahaha, abinda ya ba ni mamaki, amma ina jin haushin duk wannan. Kungiyar Miyetti Allah ta ce ta ceto daliban Kankara - kamar yadda muke bukatar hakan daga su? Akwai kadarai da yawa da suke cikin wannan al'amari.
